public Scope enterDynamicScope(JsonSchema containingSchema) {
    Scope parent = this.dynamicScopes.peek();
    this.dynamicScopes.push(newScope(null != containingSchema ? containingSchema : parent.getContainingSchema()));
    return parent;
}

If dynamicScopes empty, peek() returns null, then parent is null; then parent.getContainingSchema() would cause NullPointerException. But maybe they assume there is always a parent. However we can test behavior when dynamicScopes empty -> NPE. Also test when parent exists and containingSchema null -> uses parent's containing schema.

3. When dynamicScopes is empty (no parent). Call enterDynamicScope(null) should throw NullPointerException (since parent null). Expect exception.

4. When dynamicScopes is empty and we call enterDynamicScope(non-null S3). Since parent is null, but we provide containingSchema, the method will not use parent, it will push newScope(S3). It returns null (parent). Should not throw exception. Expect returned parent null, new scope's containing schema S3, size 1.

Let's see: public Scope getDynamicScope(); not shown implementation but likely returns dynamicScopes.peek(). We'll assume it returns top. So we can call getDynamicScope().getContainingSchema().

Thus test case 4 ensures that when no parent, but containingSchema provided, works.
